info.title: dotskit
info.description: The command-line tool of DotNetSolutionKit: makes a solution, adds services and flags to it, describes a solution made with the template alone, and upgrades a solution to a newer version of the template, keeping your changes by a three-way merge.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: dotskit - makes a solution with DotNetSolutionKit, adds services and flags to it and upgrades it, keeping your changes.
x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription:
dotskit new -N MyCompany -P MyProduct -S Orders   in a folder with no solution: make one with this service
dotskit new -S Billing --Storage true             in a solution: add a service; it takes the solution's names
dotskit new -S Orders --MongoDB true              in a solution: add a flag to a service it has

commands.name: init
commands.description: in a solution made without dotskit: describe it in its manifest

options.name: --yes
options.description: write without asking (CI)

options.name: --force
options.description: in a conflict take the template's side; your lines stay in git history

options.name: --no-build
options.description: do not build the solution after writing

options.name: --allow-dirty
options.description: new, upgrade, init (a no-op): run on a working tree with uncommitted changes, committed beside the run and taken into the merge

options.name: --template-version
options.description: init: the version a solution was made by, where it does not say

options.name: --to
options.description: upgrade: the release to go to, not newer than the tool

options.name: --conflict-style
options.description: mark a conflict with its base (|||||||), for an IDE that reads it; plain is the default

options.name: --all-at-once
options.description: upgrade: every part in one merge, instead of the shared files first, then a service at a time

options.name: --part
options.description: upgrade: the part this run takes - shared, common/<project>, capabilities or a service folder's last name
